caption:
Brotherhood in faith: want for others what you want for yourself.

The Prophet ﷺ said none of you has believed until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself. Think of one good thing you hope for, and ask Allah to give it to a friend too.

Sunan an-Nasa'i 5039 · Grade: Sahih

Which friend will you make that dua for this morning?

#brotherhood #loveforothers #goodheart #hadith
